About Specialties Approach Fees & Plans FAQ {{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Connect

Welcome — I work with people navigating change

Therapeutic care that meets you where you are.

I’m {{THERAPIST_NAME}}, a licensed clinician ({{LICENSE}}). Together we’ll build practical tools and compassionate insight to move through anxiety, relationships, trauma, and life transitions. Sessions are confidential and collaborative.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}
  • Telehealth + in-person in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}
  • Sliding scale & limited reduced-fee slots
  • Insurance consultation by request

What clients say

"I felt heard from day one. We worked at my pace and made steady changes I can actually use."

— K., client

"Practical tools for anxiety and relationships. The approach felt realistic and kind."

— M., client

"I appreciated the clarity about boundaries and confidentiality — it helped me trust the process."

— S., client

How therapy can help

Therapy is a collaborative process. Here are common outcomes my clients notice.

  • Reduce overwhelm

    Learn strategies for managing anxiety and pacing yourself through stressful times.

  • Repair relationships

    Improve communication and understanding in partnerships and family dynamics.

  • Process trauma safely

    Trauma-informed approaches that prioritize safety, pacing, and internal resources.

  • Navigate transitions

    Support for career shifts, caregiving changes, and new life phases.

Our working relationship

A clear, collaborative rhythm helps therapy feel safe and effective.

  1. 1. Reach out

    Brief intake by phone or secure message to identify concerns and logistics.

  2. 2. First session

    We review goals, confidentiality, and together craft an initial plan.

  3. 3. Ongoing sessions

    Tailored therapy using evidence-informed modalities like {{MODALITIES}} and relational work.

  4. 4. Check-ins & adjustments

    Regular review of progress and adjustments to treatment focus as needed.

Common questions

How long are sessions, and how often should I come?

Standard sessions are 50 minutes. Frequency depends on need—weekly is common to start; we can adapt over time.

Is this confidential? What about emergencies?

Yes—your privacy is protected by clinical confidentiality. I’ll explain limits (e.g., safety concerns) in the first session. If you are in crisis or an emergency, call local emergency services or a crisis line; therapy is not an emergency service.

Do you accept insurance?

I provide receipts for insurance reimbursement and can discuss options during intake. Sliding scale is available for limited slots.

More questions

Free resource: "Managing Overwhelm"

A short workbook with breathing practices and practical steps you can use between sessions.

Ready to begin?

If you’d like to talk about whether we’re a good fit, schedule a brief consultation.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Ask a question
{{BUSINESS_NAME}}

{{TAGLINE}}

Contact

{{PHONE}}
{{EMAIL}}

Policy & scope

Sessions are confidential. I provide trauma-informed, evidence-informed psychotherapy; I do not provide emergency services or medical care. If you are in crisis, call local emergency services or crisis lines immediately.

© {{BUSINESS_NAME}} — {{THERAPIST_NAME}} ({{LICENSE}})

Download: Managing Overwhelm

Enter your email to receive the workbook PDF and occasional practice notes. You may unsubscribe any time.
